notes: Three notification bug fixes: (1) showEventReminder now respects per-event sound=false setting — events with sound disabled no longer chime at at-time delivery; (2) navigator.vibrate comment corrected — was incorrectly labeled iOS Taptic Engine, clarified as Android/desktop only, no-op on iPhone; (3) playMedicalAlertChime now guards against closed AudioContext state — reinitializes before scheduling tones to prevent silent throw.
